audience: Adult learners; adjust episode audience explicitly in CONFIG.
boundary: Physical quantities and models; diagrams are illustrations unless supported by real observations.
production_handoff: Provide cited narration, timed scene directions, continuity references and generation prompts for the user's external AI video workflow. No audiovisual generation pilot is required.

topics.title: Units and definitions
topics.coverage: Quantities, units and the difference between definitions and observations.
topics.evidence_required: Pinned authoritative unit reference and exact locators.
topics.next_action: Resolve recorded idea gaps in Phase 1 before drafting narration.

topics.title: Practical realization
topics.coverage: One chain linking a definition, method and instrument.
topics.exclusions: Treating an illustrative apparatus as an actual experiment.
topics.evidence_required: Accessible method documentation and instrument limits.
topics.next_action: Resolve recorded idea gaps in Phase 1 before drafting narration.

topics.title: Measurement uncertainty
topics.coverage: Resolution, repeatability, systematic effects and reporting limits.
topics.evidence_required: Authoritative guidance and a checked illustrative example.
topics.next_action: Resolve recorded idea gaps in Phase 1 before drafting narration.

topics.title: Mechanics and idealization
topics.coverage: One motion model, assumptions and domain of validity.
topics.exclusions: Presenting a frictionless model as a direct field observation.
topics.evidence_required: Derivation and a documented comparison case.
topics.next_action: Choose a bounded case and inspect primary source availability before adding an episode idea.

topics.title: Energy and interacting systems
topics.coverage: System boundary, transfers and one mechanism chain.
topics.evidence_required: Defined boundary and a checked energy balance.
topics.next_action: Choose a bounded case and inspect primary source availability before adding an episode idea.

topics.title: Waves and signals
topics.coverage: Frequency, propagation and a bounded signal illustration.
topics.exclusions: Changing time or distance scales without disclosure.
topics.evidence_required: Equations, units and original labeled diagrams.
topics.next_action: Choose a bounded case and inspect primary source availability before adding an episode idea.

topics.title: Limits of physical models
topics.coverage: A named approximation and a regime where it fails.
topics.exclusions: Claiming the entire theory is disproved by an approximation limit.
topics.evidence_required: Original model assumptions and relevant measurements.
topics.next_action: Choose a bounded case and inspect primary source availability before adding an episode idea.

topics.title: Experimental inference
topics.coverage: Prediction, apparatus, alternative explanations and a test criterion.
topics.exclusions: AI imagery represented as measured laboratory evidence.
topics.evidence_required: Actual published protocol, results and uncertainty.
topics.next_action: Choose a bounded case and inspect primary source availability before adding an episode idea.

series.title: From units to measurements
series.entry_requirement: No prior episode required; explain specialist terms on first use.
series.learning_outcome: Distinguish definitions, practical realization and measurement uncertainty.
series.ordering_reason: A definition establishes the reference; a method realizes it; uncertainty qualifies results.
